the main factors which affect oil uptake of fried foods include oil temperature, frying time, pretreatment, oil type, and so on.

oil uptake of fried potato was affected by many factors such as oil temperature, frying time, thickness, content of water, pretreatment of salt etc., and the oil temperature, content of water and pretreatment of salt were the main affect factors, and the oil uptake could be reduced by increasing the oil temperature, reducing the content of water, and pretreating with NaCl.
the main factors of fried potato oil uptake are the oil temperature, frying time, potato thickness and the content of water.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the oil uptake of fried potato could be controlled by controlling the frying temperature and frying time, and the oil uptake of potato slices could be reduced by 20％ when the oil temperature was reduced from 180℃to 160℃, the frying time was reduced from 4min to 1.5min, and the thickness was reduced from 6mm to 2.5 mm, and the oil pickup was 30％ less when the thickness of the slices was reduced to 3mm
